title: Autonomous Navigation for Drone Swarms in GPS-Denied Environments Using Structured Learning
authors: Power W.; Pavlovski M.; Saranovic D.; Stojkovic I.; Obradovic Z.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
